verdict.rationale: Sentry explicitly markets itself as agent-less ("Drop in the SDK. No agents to install.") and evidence shows OTLP ingestion (compatible with generic OTel Collector data) plus platform SDKs, but there is no vendor-maintained host, container, or Kubernetes agent, nor cloud-service-specific instrumentation agents described. Missing for 10: dedicated host/container/K8s monitoring agents, cloud-provider-specific integrations, and any evidence of infrastructure-level (non-application) telemetry collection.
